text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We win the Unity Cup! Not only that, the hard fight our team put up helped open Riko Kashimoto's eyes and save her and her team.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa congratulates us on our success and gives us a voucher to a carrot BBQ.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She also gives us a reward befitting our team name, Blue Bloom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Riko Kashimoto and her students join us as the festivities pick up. She greets me, this time as a fellow trainer and with excitement for the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The road stretches ever onward before us. <chrname> and I promise to keep putting our best foot forward!
